dip_buy.label: Dip-Buy
dip_buy.method: block-bootstrap CI excludes 0; OOS train/test confirmed (+0.71/+0.98)
dip_buy.note: healthy>SMA200 + oversold(-5%/3d) + market-down(SPY -1.5%/3d); exit -3/+3 sell-half/trail/20d. Market-down filter ~doubles EV vs control.

earnings_drift.label: Earnings Drift
earnings_drift.method: block-bootstrap CI excludes 0 (per-date; 6624 trades -> 2044 distinct entry-dates; robust at 10/21/42d blocks); p(<=0)=0%
earnings_drift.note: pre-earnings drift; buy ~10d before earnings, sell day before. Strongest per-trade EV. Now significance-tested (overlap-aware). Blowout filter adds ~+0.19%/trade over generic drift (control also significant, CI [+0.33,+0.94]).

dip_refined.label: Dip-Buy (profile-filtered)
dip_refined.method: block-bootstrap CI excludes 0 (per-date; 8180 trades -> 449 distinct entry-dates; robust at 10/21/42d blocks); p(<=0)=0%
dip_refined.note: dip_buy + require_profile_support (HVN support / below value area). Higher EV than dip_buy, ~62% fewer setups. A refinement of dip_buy, not an independent edge; per-year robustness is the weakest of the validated three (11/16 positive).

session_node_spy.label: Session-Node Reversion
session_node_spy.note: No robust edge. /ES profile mean-reversion rejected 4 ways (naive MR, daily swing vs beta, per-year robustness, true 1-min anchor); the prior-session anchor adds no alpha over long-beta. Kept as a propose-only exploratory signal, not a backtested edge.
